metadata.name: seed-owner
metadata.description: Checks that the Hub answers as the routed test owner and refuses to do anything otherwise, then (unless the profile is 'keep') resets that owner to a known baseline through the Hub's own API: no devices, quiet hours or escalation order, or the 'reach' profile with two devices, their channels and an email-then-push escalation order.

metadata.label: Reset the routed test owner through the Hub API
